object.attr: analysis: timed from the suspects call to its answer. The fixture is the one SCALING.md's benchmark builds: one link per object of the source document, and each commit changing 1 to 3 target objects. 1,000 objects is the recommended document size, and the first time in a clone is the slowest case.
object.description: On the reference machine, the MCP server shall answer a suspects call for a document whose 1,000 links target a 1,000-object document with 1,000 commits, the first time in a clone, within TBD s.
